title: Block Groups
description: American Community Survey 2020–2024 5-year indicators for all 242,298 census block groups in the United States and Puerto Rico — the finest geography the Census Bureau publishes income, housing cost and commuting data for, typically 600–3,000 people. The indicators are split into four themed collections — [income](./bg-income/collection.json), [people](./bg-people/collection.json), [housing](./bg-housing/collection.json) and [connectivity](./bg-connectivity/collection.json) — because one wide national table would make a consumer who wanted median income download sixty columns and 242,298 rows. All four share the same geometry and `geoid`, so they join 1:1. Health insurance, disability, nativity and income by race are not published at this geography; they are in [tracts](../tracts/catalog.json). Every estimate carries its margin of error, and block-group margins are wide — read each collection's `*_cv` columns and its AGENTS.md before mapping. [data.census.gov](https://data.census.gov/) is authoritative.
